content: from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from bs4.element import Tag from app.utils.results import append_anon_view from app.models.config import Config class WidgetInjector: """Injects additional UI elements into search results.""" def __init__(self, config: Config, user_key: str, root_url: str) -> None: self.config = config self.user_key = user_key self.root_url = root_url self._av = set() # Track domains with anon view links already added def inject_favicon(self, link: Tag) -> None: """Adds icons for each returned result, using the result site's favicon Returns: None (The soup object is modified directly) """ from app.utils.misc import read_config_bool from app.models.g_classes import GClasses from app.request import Endpoint from urllib import parse as urlparse from cryptography.fernet import Fernet show_favicons = read_config_bool('WHOOGLE_SHOW_FAVICONS', True) is_valid_link = link and link.parent and link['href'].startswith('http') if not show_favicons or not is_valid_link: return parent = link.parent is_result_div = False # Check each parent to make sure that the div doesn't already have a # favicon attached, and that the div is a result div while parent: p_cls = parent.attrs.get('class') or [] if 'has-favicon' in p_cls or GClasses.scroller_class in p_cls: return elif GClasses.result_class_a not in p_cls: parent = parent.parent else: is_result_div = True break if not is_result_div: return # Construct the html for inserting the icon into the parent div parsed = urlparse.urlparse(link['href']) favicon = Fernet(self.user_key).encrypt( f'{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}/favicon.ico'.encode() ).decode() src = f'{self.root_url}/{Endpoint.element}?url={favicon}' + \ '&type=image/x-icon' html = f'' favicon_soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') link.parent.insert(0, favicon_soup) # Update all parents to indicate that a favicon has been attached parent = link.parent while parent: p_cls = parent.get('class') or [] p_cls.append('has-favicon') parent['class'] = p_cls parent = parent.parent if GClasses.result_class_a in p_cls: break def inject_anon_view(self, link: Tag) -> None: """Adds alternate viewing options for results, if not already present.""" from app.utils.results import append_anon_view from urllib import parse as urlparse if not self.config.anon_view: return netloc = urlparse.urlparse(link['href']).netloc if netloc not in self._av: self._av.add(netloc) append_anon_view(link, self.config)
